newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-WEEKEND FIXTURES IN THE SPANISH FIRST DIVISION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEEKEND FIXTURES IN THE SPANISH FIRST DIVISION.

text.p: Matches scheduled for this weekend
in the Spanish first division:
Saturday:
Racing Santander (7) vs Real Betis (4) 1930 GMT
Betis have yet to lose away from home, while Racing have
started strongly and have already taken points at their
Sardinero ground from each of the top three sides.
Sunday:
Valencia (6) vs Valladollid (5) 1600
Valladollid, unexpectedly among the front runners, hope to
keep up the pressure at Valencia's Mestalla stadium, a ground
where they have won only once in 28 visits.
Sevilla (20) vs Athletic Bilbao (8) 1600
Athletic's Julen Guerrero has led a goalrush over the past
few games but will be without injured strike partner Joseba
Exteberria against Sevilla, who have yet to win at home
Logrones (17) vs Extremadura (22) 1600
New Logrones coach Liber Arispe hopes to live up to the
Spanish saying that debutant managers always win first time out
in a game which already looks like a relegation battle.
Zaragoza (19) vs Deportivo Coruna (3) 1600
Deportivo may bring in Rafael Martin Vazquez for injured
midfielder Fran Gonzalez against a Zaragoza side urgently in
need of points to save beleaguered manager Victor Fernandez.
Real Sociedad (13) vs Hercules (21) 1600
Newly-promoted Hercules have just given manager Ivan Brzic a
vote of confidence but are looking for new players, while Real
Sociedad hope to improve after three consecutive defeats.
Espanyol (11) vs Rayo Vallecano (10) 1600
French striker Nicolas Ouedec will miss the game through
injury as Espanyol take on a surprising Rayo outfit where
Brazilian striker Guilherme is the big threat.
Atletico Madrid (12) vs Oviedo (15) 1600
Champions Atletico hope to have playmaker Jose Luis Caminero
finally back from an injury but will be without defender Santi
Denia and possibly Delfi Geli after midweek European action.
Tenerife (9) vs Celta Vigo (14) 1700
With key defender Cesar Gomez a possible non-starter, the
game will show whether Tenerife were boosted or exhausted by
their midweek UEFA Cup thriller against Lazio.
Compostela (18) vs Real Madrid (2) 1830
Real Madrid will be without defensive giant Fernando Hierro
at a ground which has become the graveyard of the big sides in
Compostela's three years at the top level.
Monday:
Sporting Gijon (16) vs Barcelona (1) 2030
Sporting coach Benito Floro has complained that referees are
over-protecting Barcelona striker Ronaldo, who is carrying an
injury and could show the effects of midweek European action.
